target.statement: Random Forest test accuracy of 90.4% (Table 2) for predicting Billboard Hot 100 inclusion on the balanced 7,180-track dataset
target.dataset: Custom dataset D: 3,590 charting + 3,590 non-charting Spotify singles (1985+), joined to Billboard Hot 100 archive

compute.basis: Modeling is trivial (Random Forest on ~7k rows), but the dataset D is not released: it requires re-querying the Spotify Web API for 30,000 tracks (now largely deprecated audio-features endpoints, rate-limited) plus scraping Billboard charts and rebuilding the title-artist fuzzy join, which is the dominant cost and may be infeasible.

blockers: Dataset D not published; must be reconstructed from scratch
Spotify audio-features/popularity API endpoints deprecated/restricted for new apps
Title-artist fuzzy matching to Billboard archive is non-trivial and error-prone
Popularity feature is time-dependent and non-reproducible
title: Beyond the Hook: Predicting Billboard Hot 100 Chart Inclusion with Machine Learning from Streaming, Audio Signals, and Perceptual Features
